newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best assigns Terra Nova "A-" rating.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best assigns Terra Nova "A-" rating.

text.p: A.M. Best said on Wednesday it had assigned Terra Nova (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd and Terra Nova Insurance Co Ltd an "A-" or "Excellent" rating, to reflect the group's strong balance sheet and management.

The insurance rating agency said in a statement the rating reflected the group's strong consolidated balance sheet, improved liquidity, disciplined exposure management, geographic risk spread, premium growth through acquisitions and experienced management team.
"A.M. Best views the company's rating outlook as positive and believes it is well positioned to maintain and enhance its position in the global marketplace," A.M. Best said.

The agency said Terra Nova's 67 percent increase in 1995 net income, and management's attempts to restructure debt, lead in a few chosen markets, strengthen underwriting, improve the capital structure and position the group to take advantage of possible acquisitions, were "significant achievements."
Terra Nova is a specialty property, casualty and marine insurance and reinsurance company operating worldwide through subsidiaries in London and Bermuda.
